<!--
  The simple purchase (model purchase@1): on a card surface, the heading and a description beside the price, one
  action and a note. Axes: layout (panel: the copy at the start, the price and the action at the end from md up,
  centered: one centred column).
-->
<script lang="ts">
export type PurchaseSimpleProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  price: string;
  note?: string;
  actionLabel?: string;
  actionHref?: string;
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  layout?: "panel" | "centered";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import LinkButton from "../compose/LinkButton.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  description = "",
  price,
  note = "",
  actionLabel = "",
  actionHref = "",
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  layout = "panel",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<PurchaseSimpleProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const box = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "panel" ? "md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between md:gap-12"
  : "items-center"
);
const copyAlign = computed(() => ((layout as string) === "panel") ? "start" : "center");
const copyText = computed(() => ((layout as string) === "panel") ? "text-start" : "text-center");
const buy = computed(() => ((layout as string) === "panel") ? "md:items-end" : "");
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
    "
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="purchase-simple"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
      <Box
        :class="cn(
          'rounded bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground border border-border',
          'flex flex-col gap-8',
          box
        )"
      >
        <Stack gap="4" :align="copyAlign" class="max-w-2xl">
          <Title :as="level" size="2xl" weight="bold" :class="cn('tracking-tight', copyText)" :id="titleId">
            {{ title }}
          </Title>
          <Text v-if="description" size="base" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', copyText)">
            {{ description }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <Stack gap="4" :align="copyAlign" :class="cn('shrink-0', buy)">
          <Text size="3xl" weight="bold" :class="cn('tracking-tight', copyText)">
            {{ price }}
          </Text>
          <LinkButton v-if="(actionLabel && actionHref)" variant="default" size="lg" :href="urlOf(actionHref)">
            {{ actionLabel }}
          </LinkButton>
          <Text v-if="note" size="xs" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', copyText)">
            {{ note }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </Box>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
